evidence.ai_role: Graph Transformer, atom-to-energy attention and learned mass-conserving spectral refinement rank candidates.
evidence.tested: New DFT calculations on an enriched 100-candidate set.
evidence.unknown: Experimental performance and independent replication were not established in the reviewed sections.

organization: Cornell University; Université catholique de Louvain; Matgenix; Griffith University; Toyota Research Institute; California Institute of Technology

source_review.scope: arXiv v1 metadata; HTML affiliations, architecture, benchmarks and prospective VB-gap results.

summary: The DeepDOSReasoner preprint reports screening 8,106 crystal structures and confirming valence-band gaps in 25 of its top 50 candidates through new density-functional-theory calculations, versus 19 of 50 for Mat2Spec. Its learned crystal-to-spectrum model guided candidate selection. The 100-material evaluation set was enriched from both models; these are computational findings, without experimental synthesis or independent replication established in the reviewed sections.
title: DeepDOSReasoner identifies materials with valence-band gaps
